dispatch.title: Dispatch within the system

assist.waiting: Waiting for the previous answer to finish…
assist.stopped: Stopped writing the answer — showing the verbatim quote.
assist.modelNote: Written by a language model — check the sources before relying on it
assist.maskedNote: Phone numbers, ID numbers, emails and bank account numbers are masked before the text is sent to the model — the real values are in the source documents: see the verbatim quote and the sources below.
assist.passagesOnly: No short answer could be quoted — see the related passages below.
assist.noEvidence: No document you are allowed to see covers this. Try rephrasing, or use Search.
assist.historyNote: Questions and answers stay on this page only and are not stored on the server — reloading the page clears them.
